about: The Cross-Gen Deluxe Bundle includes: - Cross-Gen Deluxe Bundle of Tony Hawk's™ Pro Skater™ 1 + 2 -- Includes PS4™ and PS5™ version of the game - Digital Deluxe Edition Content: -- ‘The Ripper’ skater from Powell-Peralta® -- Unique…

Play Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ & Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 2 in one epic collection, rebuilt from the ground up in incredible HD. All the pro skaters, levels and tricks are back and fully-remastered, plus more.
